popup.title: Shutter Safari 3.0
popup.description: Shutter Safari 3.0 is a flagship photography competition focused on storytelling through visuals. The event includes two photography rounds, where participants capture and submit photos based on given themes. This time, we’ve come up with an exciting Bonus Videography Round, where participants capture their journey to Paradox along with their on-campus experiences. Shortlisted entries will be judged by experts, making the event a perfect blend of creativity, storytelling, and learning.
